Splitting units across contracts or display stacks changes no losses; operational locks do not create starvation immunity.

Provider/client swaps and retries cannot refill charges or bypass quotas; rejected/idempotent commands incur no additional fee or successful-action count.

scope: Execute scenarios for account farms, gift concentration, bond/default cycling, training/bond storage sheltering, indefinite owned-defender pinning, smear campaigns, and model-tier differences.
Validate investigation evidence, review permissions, conduct notices, appeals, and alerting; preserve legitimate alliances and gifts instead of treating size or success as guilt.
acceptance: Every scenario has observed effects, a documented permitted/prohibited classification, and reproducible evidence.
Release-blocking exploit or policy-enforcement failures receive fixes and reruns; model fairness and abuse resistance are not claimed from action caps alone.

tasks.title: Implement StoreKit and Google Play cosmetic purchases
scope: Implement store products/price display, signed server receipt validation, entitlement reconciliation, refund/revoke notifications, and restore paths for iOS/Android.
Maintain platform-origin paid Gem lots, shared earned Gems, and account-wide cosmetic ownership using the existing commerce interface.
acceptance: Replayed or cross-account receipts, pending/canceled purchases, out-of-order refunds, and reinstall cannot grant twice.
Spent consumable packs are not re-credited by restore; origin-restricted balances display correctly and never affect game resources, score, or run limits.
blocked_by_external: Apple/Google developer and merchant accounts; sandbox products and test users

tasks.title: Implement Telegram Stars cosmetic purchases
scope: Implement server-priced Stars invoices, bounded pre-checkout validation, verified successful-payment processing, deduplicated grants, support/refund handling, and source-tagged Gem lots.
Keep web checkout out of Telegram purchase paths; cosmetic catalog and account entitlements use the same commerce service.
acceptance: Invoice creation or pre-checkout alone never grants Gems; duplicate updates/refunds and forwarded invoices cannot alter the wrong account.
Purchases preserve origin restrictions and account-wide cosmetic ownership without changing gameplay; failed payment retains a clear recoverable state.
blocked_by_external: Telegram bot with Stars test and production payment capability

tasks.title: Provision and rehearse production operations
scope: Promote and rehearse the phase-0 single-VPS stack for production with separate production database/secrets, encrypted off-host backup/restore, secrets/signing rotation, monitoring, status page, capacity alarms, migrations, and deployment rollback.

Replace MVP-local backup and email capture with encrypted off-host backup/restore and real outbound SMTP, then configure support/moderation/privacy ownership, incident world suspension, delayed/failed notifications, provider outage handling, and retention/legal-hold operations.
acceptance: Rehearse a production-like restore, deletion suppression, outbox replay, signing-key rotation, credential incident, and world pause/resume before admitting players.
Operators can diagnose and recover without manual unlogged balance edits; registration/checkout stay disabled when required operational configuration is missing.
blocked_by_external: Production access to the project VPS, domain/DNS, encrypted off-host backup target, SMTP credentials, and operator coverage

tasks.title: Re-certify external clients and complete distribution
scope: Repeat full real-game connection, read/write, authority approval, bounded run, revoke, and reconnect checks for all five adapters plus ChatGPT and Claude on the release candidate.
Submit and complete required external-client distribution reviews; publish tested plans/platforms/models/dates and a generic MCP guide.

Certify Gemini CLI and the Grok-powered external tool client with real eligible accounts, and run the deferred five-person-per-route unaided setup study; clearly separate API model support from consumer-chat installation availability.
acceptance: All required routes and the deferred unfamiliar-user setup study pass against production-like endpoints and shipped schemas, not just phase-0 fixtures.
Review acceptance and host availability are evidenced before advertising support; a private developer connection is not represented as universal installation.
blocked_by_external: Eligible release host accounts and any required distribution approvals

tasks.title: Prepare and certify mobile-store and Telegram distribution
scope: Prepare iOS/Android signed releases, privacy/data disclosures, account deletion access, report/block controls, review accounts, production app links/push, and supported-device testing.
Complete required store reviews, Telegram Mini App/bot metadata/deep links, and each channel’s digital-purchase checks; record policy versions and acceptance evidence.
acceptance: Release artifacts are reproducible and the tested binaries match submitted builds; production links resolve to the correct account/destination.
Required reviews/disclosures and purchase checks pass; web availability alone cannot mark native/Telegram distribution done.
blocked_by_external: Apple/Google distribution approvals; production Telegram bot/domain configuration

tasks.title: Certify the full production channel matrix
scope: Repeat handoff/approval/revoke/inbox/model-run fixtures across the production-like web, signed native apps, Telegram, and certified assistant clients.
Rehearse channel outage, store/Stars refund replay, device reinstall, stale client API version, account deletion, and external-host feature unavailability.
acceptance: Each required surface has evidence tied to its build/client version and backend revision; advertised capability labels match actual supported routes.
Cross-surface entitlements, run leases, event state, and privacy controls remain consistent; a blocked store review or failed required channel blocks release.

tasks.title: Rehearse Season One end to end
scope: Run an accelerated complete season against the release candidate, then validate signup/invitations, mixed-provider negotiations, scarcity, raids, privacy deletion, public evidence, purchases/refunds, and final honors.
Execute final accessibility, load, security, provider-error, and recovery regressions at the planned release capacity and record the tested limit.
acceptance: L01–L06 have linked evidence; no asset/progression/receipt inconsistency appears across the season boundary or a restore.
Critical defects are fixed and their affected scenarios rerun; a 50-player slice test is not mislabeled proof of unlimited global-world capacity.

tasks.title: Replace MVP operator placeholders with reviewed production facts
scope: Replace every synthetic MVP controller, address, contact, ownership, terms/privacy, privacy-request, processor, agreement, data-location, transfer, and email-sender value with reviewed production facts.
Verify production staff MFA, public notices, outbound email, privacy requests, and processor/transfer records before enabling production or paid signup.
acceptance: No test domain, temporary owner, placeholder agreement, synthetic-data restriction, or captured-only sender remains in the production operator register or public notices.
The production preflight and independent review pass against the deployed register before any production or paid account is admitted.
blocked_by_external: Actual operator identity, public legal contacts, reviewed notices, and processor agreements

tasks.title: Accept and prepare the Season One release
scope: Assemble the release revision, schema/rules versions, supported-client matrix, migration plan, tested capacity, operator roster, rollback runbook, season configuration, and pass/fail register. Include native/Telegram builds, store approval evidence, and the tested client capability matrix.
Prepare the deploy command and controlled signup enablement; actual release execution is a separate explicit operational action, not an effect of generating this backlog.
acceptance: Every L01–L06 criterion passes, including native/Telegram distribution, verified payments, and the complete channel matrix; all blocking defects/external reviews are closed.
The release record names who can pause/recover the world and provides a reproducible go/no-go checklist; no task is marked completed merely because it is scheduled.

size_legend.S: Small bounded change or evidence review
size_legend.M: Several collaborating components with a focused test suite
size_legend.L: Cross-cutting lifecycle or integration, usually delivered as multiple reviewable pull requests
